readmeRightsLines: - `data/gpt-image-2-prompts.json`: full enriched prompt bundle with prompt text, variables, preview images, tags, input modes, references, and attribution fields.
- Keep source case URLs and attribution fields when reusing prompts or images.

Validate the bundle with `schema/gpt-image-2-prompt.schema.json`. Top-level fields record `schemaVersion`, `generatedAt`, `source`, `count`, and `templates`. Each template includes its public ID and slug, title, category and tags, model and input mode, prompt text and localized variants, reusable variables, reference-image requirements, aspect ratio, public preview URLs, source attribution, publication time, and SEO summary. Private review status, GSC metrics, internal source URLs, ranking weights, and API credentials are intentionally excluded.
## Attribution, Opt-out, and Commercial Reuse

This repository is a normalized discovery dataset, not a blanket license for every prompt or image. Keep item-level source attribution, review model-provider terms, and check trademarks, packaging, likeness, privacy, and media rights before commercial publication. To correct attribution or request removal of a prompt or preview, [open an issue](https://github.com/Toolcentral-ai/awesome-gpt-image-2-prompts/issues) with the public case URL and evidence; maintainers will review the source record and update both the dataset and web gallery when appropriate.
